$comment: The spec/plan loop (design §5.8, §5.9; contract §10): one definition for the runner-driven loop and every native engine (Claude workflow, Grok Rhai, ZCode driver). Round 0 runs the mode's authors; every later round N runs draft-check, the critic and, unless a stop rule fires, the revise authors, all on the drafts of round N-1 (drafts_read). Each author writes its draft and, optionally, its own decision points (decisions.<role>.rN.json, items as draft-result decisionPoints; an absent file means none). Engines are pinned to this file by the engine parity test.

spec+plan.$comment: feature and full: the spec from the request, then the plan derived from that spec; the critic checks both and the fit between them.

plan.$comment: The plan flow, from an existing approved spec.

bugfix-plan.$comment: bugfix: no spec; the plan carries ## Bug and ## Acceptance Criteria before its first task (design §5.19).

stop.clean: The critic says clean and the round's validator file has no errors and no strict-mode warnings.
stop.no-progress: The critic returns the same issue keys as the previous round; those issues become residual notes.
stop.max-rounds: round == max_rounds: after the last revision a final critic runs and its open issues become residual notes.
